kind: Functional regression comparison; synthetic fixtures, no raw logs
source_identity: The history owner did not change upstream between the baseline and PR base; recorded regression was repeated on the rebased candidate.

packaged_app.baseline: A late 503 reopens a history warning after recovery.
packaged_app.candidate: The recovered warning stays hidden; current and historical messages, draft and sending remain available; no new model Turn is started.

real_backend.scope: Packaged UI with real isolated Python Chat HTTP server and ChatSessionStore; late result revisions, read failure/recovery, quiet reads, no duplicates, stable store hashes and zero model Turns.
real_backend.cleanup: Route callbacks are awaited before closing the browser; successful assertions are followed by successful command exit.

build: Dashboard and packaged Chat build plus source verification passed on candidate.
prerequisites: Node.js 22.22.3+, Python 3.11+, installed repository Node dependencies and Playwright Chromium.
limits: Controlled HTTP ordering and synthetic states; not production incident rates
No live provider/model lifecycle, production-load, Windows desktop or full CI qualification
smoke:conversation-history had a separate fixture expectation failure on the earlier baseline; this PR does not claim a full-suite pass.
